29: Therefore he may indeed stipulate with her concerning any case in which she would become forbidden - and she would have become forbidden to him forever on account of her committing adultery during the first period of marriage. The same applies to adultery committed during the period of her marriage to his brother, as is stated in the first chapter [Sotah 2a:3]: "And if her husband dies she performs ḥalitza and may not enter into levirate marriage"
